title: phaleria revoluta
intro: Phaleria revoluta, commonly known as the 'Variegated Phaleria' or 'Javan Currant', is a tropical plant native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the Rutaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of sleep quality, and its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phaleria revoluta are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exhibit anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of Phaleria revoluta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its pharmacological properties.
